status_legend.verified: Fetched from `url` during a recorded run. `excerpt` is verbatim and supports the listed codes/components.
status_legend.located: The source is confirmed to exist at `url` (title/publisher confirmed), but no supporting excerpt has been recorded yet. Counts as grounded for coverage, but is queued for verification.
status_legend.unverified: Cited in the codebook but not checked in any recorded run. The verifier's queue.
status_legend.misattributed: The codebook's current attribution is wrong (wrong author, wrong regulation, wrong component). Must carry an `open_cp` until fixed.
status_legend.needs_replacement: The citation is too vague to verify (no named document). Must carry an `open_cp` until replaced.
